department: Rowan-Virtua School of Translational Biomedical Engineering & Sciences

deadline.value: Rolling admissions: application review begins December 15 and continues until all positions are filled, with most decisions made between January and April.
deadline.quote: Rolling: review begins December 15 and continues until all positions are filled

also.quote: The application review period begins after December 15, with most decisions being made between January and April.

gre_general.value: Submission of GRE scores is optional for TBES Ph.D. programs.
gre_general.quote: PhD programs: submission of GRE is optional.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Cell and Molecular Biology (Biomedical Sciences).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is determined by the Admissions Committee with an interview and first-year laboratory rotations; pre-admission supervisor commitment is not required.

funding.value: All Ph.D. students in good academic standing receive the same funding package: a $35,000 annual stipend, full tuition remission/waiver, and paid health insurance and most student fees.
funding.quote: Yes, the scholarship is the same for all students, as long as the student stays in good academic standing: A competitive stipend, waived tuition, paid health insurance and most student fees are paid.

also.quote: PhD students can expect to receive a stipend of $35,000 per year, tuition remission, and paid enrollment in University-sponsored health insurance plan.

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate (bachelor's) degree from an accredited college or university is required.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university is required.
